cohort: The review included studies on women with Gestational Diabetes Mellitus (GDM) and their offspring.
finding: This integrative review found that psychosocial well-being interacted with diet and physical activity in women with GDM, and combined lifestyle interventions improved diet, physical activity, stress perception, BMI, metabolic outcomes, and reduced the risks of postpartum diabetes, preterm deliveries, and low birth weight.
